comments.author: Hopply
comments.body_html:
If you have ServerValueModifier (you should, it’s basically an essential mod) you can do this without downloading an extra mod.

1. Install and open SVM
2. Click on ‘‘Traders services’’ and next to it click the power button to green.
3. In Traders services, click on the far right ‘‘Armor repair won’t wear durability’’ and ‘‘Weapon repair won’t wear durability’’.
4. (optional for preference) Also in ‘‘Inventory and items’’ tab, you can turn off (or on in the menu) Weapon overheating. Makes it so when you’re full autoing, you can actually full auto for more than 90 rounds before the weapon stops firing. JUST PREFERENCE, I personally hate overheating, it’s way too fast in tarkov. ALSO REMEMBER TO TURN ON THE INVENTORY AND ITEMS TAB BY PRESSING POWER BUTTON TO GREEN!
5. Click apply on bottom left of the application window.

Hope this helps. -Jay
